metadata.description: Claude Code plugins from LR (Living Runtime): memory that survives compaction and spans every session, and COL, which checks claims against what actually ran.

plugins.name: lr-memory
plugins.description: A verbatim working note across compaction, a search over every past session (the recall skill), and a daily sleep pass that turns your own words into memory rules (the sleep skill). The note and the search are local and spend no model tokens.

plugins.name: col
plugins.description: Checks Claude's last message against what ran (commits it names, files it cites, test counts it gives), keeps a ledger of measurable predictions before long jobs and irreversible steps and compares them with the results, stops a commit or push that would carry a key, and asks for rival explanations when a fix does not hold. Local; no model calls.
